scripts.dev: nodemon --watch scss/ --ext scss,html --exec "npm run build:css & vite"
scripts.build:css: sass scss/groupui.scss dist/groupui.css --no-source-map && npm run build:css:mini
scripts.test: docker run --network=host --ipc=host --rm -v $(pwd):/groupui-css-framework -w /groupui-css-framework mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble /bin/bash -c "npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ --global && npm i && npm install -g @go-task/cli && npx playwright test --project=chrome-desktop-screenshots --project=firefox-screenshots --project=safari-screenshots ./scss/components/$npm_config_component"
scripts.test:update: docker run --network=host --ipc=host --rm -v $(pwd):/groupui-css-framework -w /groupui-css-framework mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble /bin/bash -c "npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ --global && npm i && npm install -g @go-task/cli && npx playwright test --project=chrome-desktop-screenshots --project=firefox-screenshots --project=safari-screenshots ./scss/components/$npm_config_component -u changed"
scripts.test:a11y: docker run --network=host --ipc=host --rm -v $(pwd):/groupui-css-framework -w /groupui-css-framework mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble /bin/bash -c "npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ --global && npm i && npm install -g @go-task/cli && npx playwright test --project=chrome-a11y --project=firefox-a11y --project=safari-a11y ./scss/components/$npm_config_component"
scripts.stylelint: stylelint "**/*.scss" --config .stylelintrc.json && echo '✓ All SCSS files passed linting'
scripts.checkstyle: npm run stylelint && npm run prettier
scripts.checkstyle:fix: npm run stylelint:fix && npm run prettier:write
